tools.name: show_passage
tools.description: Point the reader at one or more paragraphs of THIS article. Instant and free — use it whenever your answer rests on a passage, which is most of the time. The reader sees them highlighted and can jump to them. Say in words where you are pointing ('the rainstorm thought experiment'); never read the ids aloud.

blockIds.description: Block ids from the article below, e.g. spya-k3m9qt. Two or three at most.

why.description: A few words naming what is in the passage, for the label beside it.

event.text: It shows how a statistically significant result can still be very unlikely to be true when researchers test huge numbers of possibilities. In the example, with 100,000 gene variants tested, a barely significant finding raises the odds only slightly; bias or many teams testing the same question can make it even less convincing.
